capability_rules.name: Approved private package registries
capability_rules.rationale: Package access must authenticate to approved private registries and deny unapproved sources.

capability_rules.name: Approved-region deployment
capability_rules.rationale: Regional deployment must be configurable across the approved region set.

capability_rules.name: Dedicated tenancy
capability_rules.rationale: Execution services must preserve a dedicated customer tenancy boundary.

capability_rules.name: Durable audit retention
capability_rules.rationale: The audit ledger must preserve immutable records for the required retention period.

capability_rules.name: Enterprise scale
capability_rules.rationale: Shared control-plane services must support enterprise developer population and concurrency.

capability_rules.name: Microsoft Entra workforce federation
capability_rules.rationale: The workforce identity service must federate Entra users and groups.

capability_rules.name: GitLab SaaS integration
capability_rules.rationale: The source-control adapter must support GitLab SaaS events and APIs.

capability_rules.name: MicroVM isolation
capability_rules.rationale: Every selected active execution service must provide a MicroVM isolation boundary.

capability_rules.name: Private connectivity
capability_rules.rationale: Control-plane and execution traffic must remain on approved private paths.

capability_rules.name: Restricted runtime egress
capability_rules.rationale: Selected execution and tool services must enforce explicit outbound destinations.
